text: Staff and Sword, On Foot
A walking staff for his spells and a plain Imperial blade for anything that gets too close. He walks, as he always has.
Staff and Sword, Barded Warhorse
A walking staff for his spells and a plain Imperial blade for anything that gets too close. An armoured Imperial charger, trained not to shy at spellfire.
Staff and Sword, Imperial Pegasus
A walking staff for his spells and a plain Imperial blade for anything that gets too close. A winged Imperial steed that carries him over the enemy line.
Staff and Sword, Disc of Tzeentch
A walking staff for his spells and a plain Imperial blade for anything that gets too close. A floating daemon disc of Tzeentch. He does not talk about what he paid for it.
Staff and Sword, Carmine Dragon
A walking staff for his spells and a plain Imperial blade for anything that gets too close. A blood-red dragon of the old Empire. It has seen more endings than he has.

Iron Hand, On Foot
No weapon at all. He fights with open hands and the weight of a forge behind every blow, the way the dragon-blooded lords of Cathay do. He walks, as he always has.
Iron Hand, Battering Ram
Nothing stops or knocks him down. He bowls men over and flings them aside, and every blow cracks the armour of what it hits. He counts as a large target.
The Steward's Seal
The seal of a house that ended long ago. He still presses it into the wax before every order, and the men still read it as a promise.
The Unwritten Grimoire
Every page is blank until he needs it. Then it holds the spell, the counter-spell and a note in his own hand about what went wrong last time.
The Old Archivist
Older than the Advisor, or so he claims. He keeps every name, every debt and every door that was left unlocked.
Mantle of Many Wars
Patched from the cloaks of every army he has marched with. Nothing gets through it that has not already been stopped once before.
Lantern of the Long Watch
It burns without oil and never gives away the camp. Whoever carries it is never the one surprised.
Edge of Final Counsel
Not a blade he swings. It is the one he points at a map, and the army goes where it points.
